heard: Winnie the Pooh was a black bear cub bought for $20. On August 24, 1914, cavalry veterinarian Lieutenant Harry Colborne found her at a train stop in White River, Ontario. He named the bear Winnie after his hometown of Winnipeg, Manitoba. Winnie then sailed to England with Canadian troops aboard the SS Manitou on October 3, 1914. She proudly served as the mascot for the Canadian Army Veterinary Corps. Colborne left Winnie at the London Zoo in December 1914, before heading to the battlefields of France. There, young Christopher Robin Milney fell in love with her gentle personality during frequent visits. Winnie the Pooh was a black bear cub bought for $20.
